text: Acceptance 1/11 (GC5): an instance admin outside a private conversation can retrieve its topic through updateConversation. Route reproduction: authenticated non-member admin gets 403 from GET /api/conversations/1, but PATCH /api/conversations/1 with {} returns 200 containing topic PRIVATE_TOPIC_FIXTURE. Check canRead before returning conversation content, or return a content-free acknowledgement for administrative operations without membership.
